_about: Stage 8d: the rule document GM fiat cites. A fall, a fire, acid, cold — numbers the
model used to write into a bare `damage`. Each row declares its slot (the one scalar
only the fiction supplies, with bounds) and the dice per unit of it; the engine
rolls the row, never the model. Core Rulebook, Environment chapter, as cited per row.
Traps are not here: a trap is its own document and stays narrated this stage.

falling.name: a fall
falling.source: CRB, Environment: Falling — 1d6 per 10 feet, to a maximum of 20d6; a deliberate jump makes the first 1d6 nonlethal

catching-fire.name: catching fire
catching-fire.source: CRB, Environment: Catching on Fire — 1d6 fire per round until extinguished

burning-brush.name: burning brush
burning-brush.source: CRB, Environment: Catching on Fire (aonprd.com/Rules.aspx?ID=331) — characters exposed to burning oil, bonfires and noninstantaneous magic fires 'are allowed a DC 15 Reflex saving throw' to avoid catching fire, and one who catches 'takes 1d6 points of damage immediately'; Burning Hands: 'Flammable materials burn if the flames touch them'. Ground a fire spell has lit is a bonfire to whoever stands in it.
burning-brush.not_yet: The book's fire goes on burning a creature each round after it catches, until a Reflex save succeeds (+4 rolling on the ground, at once in water), even once it has stepped out. A per-creature fire exists since alchemy lane C (2026-10-06): `state.burning` with its own per-round damage (Engine._op_burn) and the `extinguish` op (Reflex against the fire's DC, its rolling bonus, water smothers), which alchemist's fire lays. This row's ward does not lay it yet: here the risk is still asked each round a creature stands in the burning squares, and ends when it leaves them.

smoke.name: smoke
smoke.source: CRB, Environment: Smoke Effects — 'A character who breathes heavy smoke must make a Fortitude save each round (DC 15, +1 per previous check) or spend that round choking and coughing. A character who chokes for 2 consecutive rounds takes 1d6 points of nonlethal damage. Smoke obscures vision, giving concealment (20% miss chance) to characters within it.'
smoke.not_yet: The concealment is the smoke's own obscuring squares. The choking is simplified: a ward holds one DC for everyone and cannot count a creature's previous checks or its consecutive rounds, so a failed Fortitude save costs the 1d6 nonlethal at once, where the book waits for a second failure in a row and raises the DC by one a check. As a cited `hazard` the row is the book's: one 1d6 per two rounds of choking.

lava.name: lava
lava.source: CRB, Environment: Lava Effects — 2d6 fire per round of contact; 20d6 per round immersed

acid.name: acid
acid.source: CRB, Environment: Acid Effects — 1d6 per round of contact; 10d6 per round immersed

cold.name: exposure to cold
cold.source: CRB, Environment: Cold Dangers — 1d6 nonlethal per hour of exposure below 40°F on a failed Fortitude save
cold.save_note: Added 2026-10-01 with carried gear (content/rules/gear.json): the source line always said 'on a failed Fortitude save' and the row rolled the damage with no save at all. 'Fortitude save each hour (DC 15, +1 per previous check)'; 'A character who takes any nonlethal damage from cold or exposure is beset by frostbite or hypothermia (treat her as fatigued).' The save reads the roll context {against: cold}, so a cold-weather bonus reaches it.

heat.name: exposure to heat
heat.source: CRB, Environment: Heat Dangers — 1d4 nonlethal per hour above 90°F on a failed Fortitude save
heat.save_note: Added 2026-10-09 with Endurance's computed clauses: like the cold row before 2026-10-01, the source line always said 'on a failed Fortitude save' and the row rolled the damage with no save at all. CRB, Heat Dangers: 'a character in very hot conditions (above 90° F) must make a Fortitude saving throw each hour (DC 15, +1 for each previous check) or take 1d4 points of nonlethal damage' and 'A character who takes any nonlethal damage from heat exposure now suffers from heatstroke and is fatigued.' The save reads the roll context {against: heat}, which Endurance's +4 asks. Not modelled: the -4 on the save for heavy clothing or armour of any sort, the extreme bands (above 110° F, above 140° F) and the Survival check's +4 for a guide.

starvation.name: starvation
starvation.source: CRB, Environment: Starvation and Thirst — 1d6 nonlethal per day without food past the first three

thirst.name: thirst
thirst.source: CRB, Environment: Starvation and Thirst — 1d6 nonlethal per hour without water past the first day
